prompt:
30% of seeds in a packet are a red variety. Ten seeds are chosen at random.

**(a)** State two assumptions needed to model the number of red seeds by $B(10,\,0.3)$. **[2]**

**(b)** Find the probability that exactly 3 are red. **[1]**

**(c)** Find the probability that at least 2 are red. **[1]**
markscheme:
**(a)** Each seed is independently red or not; the probability 0.3 is constant for each seed (e.g. a large packet) **(R2)**

**(b)** $\binom{10}{3}0.3^{3}0.7^{7}\approx0.267$ **(A1)**

**(c)** $1-P(X\le1)\approx0.851$ **(A1)**

concept: Mean and variance of the binomial
